image_query: Dancing Girl Mohenjo-daro bronze statue National Museum New Delhi
tweets: The Dancing Girl of Mohenjo-daro, just 10.5 cm of bronze, cast nearly 4,500 years ago by the lost-wax method: wax shaped, sealed in clay, then melted away as molten metal took its place. One arm in bangles, hip cocked, utterly at ease. National Museum, New Delhi.
